text:
Rhea N: quick brain dump - proposing a minimal local-fallback pattern for canaries: a tiny "judger" beside the router that can only execute guardrailed actions from a signed policy blob. want to capture failure modes.
Owen G: +1. main goals: (1) allow recovery during control-plane latency spikes, (2) keep auditability & central intent.
Liang Z: guardrail fields we need: policy_id, allowed_fallbacks, cohorts, max_flips_per_window, ttl_secs, dry_run_flag, signer_kid. keep blob <2KB.
Rhea N: decision modes: passive (log only), emergency (flip on infra hard-trigger), auto (flip on infra hard-trigger + agree to soft reductions for quality signals). default deploy is passive.
Owen G: signals: infra signals (p95/p99 latency, http_5xx_rate, token_timeouts) are allowed to trigger hard flips. async semantic quality signals only allowed to reduce weight or mark regression but not hard flip.
Liang Z: hysteresis: require condition to hold for 3 consecutive windows (10s windows) before a hard flip. cooldown: once flipped, lock for 60s with reduced sensitivity. flip_count metric should be emitted.
Rhea N: revocation: control plane pushes revokes on a fanout channel; agents also poll a compact PRL every 5s as fallback. auto-revoke rules available (e.g., if control-plane detects model-quality delta > X + 500 spike).
Owen G: security: sign blobs with CP HSM key. edges verify KID/thumbprint. we rotate signing keys weekly; public KIDs published via control-plane discovery. only CP can issue full-permission blobs; ops can issue short-lived safe-policies for emergency.
Liang Z: runbook excerpt:
- passive: agent reports decisions to /observability/judger/passive and does NOT change routing
- emergency: agent may flip to allowed_fallbacks, emits incident event and writes compact audit event to CP
- auto: agent flips and also posts a reconcile event so CP can reconcile state and metrics
PagerBot: alert: judger.flip_count > 3 on router-canary-7 at 1799998890
Owen G: flip-flop protection: if flip_count > 3 in 10m escalate to control-plane rollback and force passive mode on that agent.
Rhea N: KV warmup caveat: fallback may miss KV cache. options: (A) accept cold-KV penalty and emit fallback_cost estimate, (B) synchronous warm on small sample (costly). we'll document expected transient latency and include a fallback_cost_metric.
Liang Z: testing: chaos tests must simulate missed push notifications and verify PRL reconciliation fixes partial revokes. include dry-run revoke where agents only report intended actions.
Owen G: observability: emit judger.policy_id, judger.mode, judger.flip_reason, judger.reconcile_latency, judger.flip_count, judger.fallback_cost_est. trace spans must include policy_id and decision_version.
Rhea N: ownership: control plane produces blobs and PRL, infra owns edge agent runtime, SRE owns alerting thresholds.
DeployBot: judger v0.1 passive roll to router-canary-7 started at 1799998910 by liang
Liang Z: action items: i'll spec the compact blob proto + PRL format; Owen will draft playbook for escalation; Rhea will add RFC addendum and observability template.
Rhea N: thanks everyone. goal: fast, auditable, safest-local decisions without sacrificing central control. :thumbsup:
